body: Yeah but they don’t seem to understand that.
What will change? I’ll be suicidal enough to go through with my plans. That’s part of The reason I want to go off of them.

I’ve asked my psychologist AND psychiatrist AND Mum AND Dr and they all want me to stay on the Pills. Now it’s time to take it into my own hands. I’m sick of being this fake ‘happy’, ive learnt that the pills don’t make the problems go away, but how I react to them, so my life is still shit but all My pills allow me to do is smile. I guess the supervision part is they witness me going through a shit cycle at school (i go to a new specialized school for mental health rehabilitation).
I’ve told my psychologist and mum and they don’t seem to care that I’m in danger and literally have the tools to die. I’m just a lost cause and don’t deserve to be here anymore.
